correctness.rationale: BC=CB=D forces D²=0 and annihilation BD=DB=CD=DC=0. The adapted decomposition E⊕H⊕F gives B and C as upper-block matrices with PH0=US=I, PS=UH0=0, so two disjoint t-dimensional injections into H require n>=4t. Their counts are I_q(n-2t,t) and q^{t²}I_q(n-3t,t); free P,U extension and Q,V blocks contribute q^{2t(n-4t)+2t²}. The remaining R,T mutually annihilate and square to zero on a complement of dimension n-4t, giving Z_{n-4t}(q). For D=0, a flag U=im B+im C contained in K=ker B∩ker C and two subspace-Möbius inversions derive Z_n(q) with no overcount. Directly calculated q=2 rank-1 n=4 and 5 fiber predictions 24 and 672; verified n=4 n>=4t boundary.
residual_risks: Computations are bounded corroboration; arbitrary-domain correctness follows from the mathematical block, wedge, orbit or EF proof, not finite tests.
